When we first pulled up to La Quinta by Wyndham Bodrum at midnight we thought, “Wait… is this it?” The entrance is surprisingly modest—nothing flashy. Once checked in we where taken to our rooms by Ibrahim. We walked through blooming flower canopy, and suddenly we where in a stylish hotel that feels way more upscale than you expected. We booked all inclusive package with sea-view room, breakfast, lunch and evening dinner and we could have honestly just stayed on the balcony the entire trip. The view was excellent with sparkling blue water, boats and Kos Island in the distance. The location is spot-on. It’s a short, walk to the marina with restaurants, bars, the hotel itself is quiet enough. Overall, La Quinta is full of nice surprises. It may not look like much from the street, but inside it's comfy, welcoming, and perfectly placed The staff were genuinely warm and helpful, quick with recommendations from Emre and always up for a friendly chat. As for the food, breakfast was a fresh fruits, cheeses, breads and hot side options. Lunch and evening meal menu was extensive with salad, hot options and assortment of desserts. The pool area was clean, not too crowded, and perched high enough to catch sea breezes while you lounge with drinks and food from the snack bar. La Quinta surprised us in the best way. It's not trying to be flashy, but it nails the comfort, location, and views. Definitely one of those places where you feel like you got more than you paid for.
